name: Ragefire Chasm
notes: Short Orgrimmar cave run against Burning Blade cultists and troggs. Forever lists the four usual bosses with their Classic loot; Zelemar is an optional quest-summoned boss in Classic and is not listed by Forever loot trackers. Forever reworked many Classic items (level/quality/stats), so exact stats may differ.

name: The Deadmines
notes: Defias Brotherhood hideout under Westfall ending on VanCleef's ship. Forever trackers show the Classic boss loot unchanged so far; Forever gives the Blackened Defias leather set a new set bonus. Forever reworked many Classic items (level/quality/stats), so exact stats may differ.

name: Wailing Caverns
notes: Druids of the Fang dungeon in the Barrens; Mutanus appears after escorting the Disciple of Naralex. Forever keeps Classic loot so far and gives the Embrace of the Viper set a new set bonus. Forever reworked many Classic items (level/quality/stats), so exact stats may differ.

name: Shadowfang Keep
notes: Arugal's worgen-infested keep in Silverpine. In Forever, loot trackers flag Haunting Blade and Phantom Armor from the Deathsworn Captain (a rare spawn whose drops were largely unavailable in Classic Era) as new; Sever is a Scourge Invasion event boss whose loot is not yet seen in Forever. Forever reworked many Classic items (level/quality/stats), so exact stats may differ.

name: The Stockade
notes: Stormwind prison riot dungeon, raised to 26-32 in Forever. Classic bosses had almost no loot, but Forever trackers list two to four items per boss (e.g. Hamhock's Cleaver, Debt Collector, Prison Shank); those Forever-only items are not in the Classic item data so they appear in bosses/notableLoot only, not as gear entries. Forever reworked many Classic items (level/quality/stats), so exact stats may differ.

name: Blackfathom Deeps
notes: Flooded night elf temple in Ashenvale held by naga and the Twilight's Hammer. Forever loot tables mirror Classic so far; Baron Aquanis is a Horde quest-summoned boss. Forever reworked many Classic items (level/quality/stats), so exact stats may differ.

name: Razorfen Kraul
notes: Quilboar thorn-maze in the southern Barrens. Forever loot matches Classic so far; a new Quilboar Blaster appears as a dungeon quest reward. Forever reworked many Classic items (level/quality/stats), so exact stats may differ.

name: Gnomeregan
notes: Irradiated gnome capital under Dun Morogh. Forever trackers show Classic boss loot; no new drops confirmed yet. Forever reworked many Classic items (level/quality/stats), so exact stats may differ.

name: Scarlet Monastery: Graveyard
notes: Undead-haunted crypt wing of the Monastery. Forever adds a new Polished Skullcap (mail head) to Bloodmage Thalnos, and news coverage says Forever is turning some Scarlet Monastery junk loot into real gear. Ironspine, Azshir and the Fallen Champion are rare spawns; Scorn was a Scourge Invasion boss in Classic. Forever reworked many Classic items (level/quality/stats), so exact stats may differ.

name: Scarlet Monastery: Library
notes: Library wing; Doan's mantle and robe are the classic caster upgrades. Loot matches Classic so far in Forever trackers. Forever reworked many Classic items (level/quality/stats), so exact stats may differ.

name: Scarlet Monastery: Armory
notes: Training-hall wing ending on Herod. Loot matches Classic so far; the wing shares the Monastery-wide trash drops. Forever reworked many Classic items (level/quality/stats), so exact stats may differ.

name: Scarlet Monastery: Cathedral
notes: Final wing with the Mograine and Whitemane double fight. Forever trackers list Classic loot and add Scarlet Leggings to Mograine and Captain's Buckler/Jouster's Chestplate to Whitemane (unconfirmed placements). Forever reworked many Classic items (level/quality/stats), so exact stats may differ.

name: Razorfen Downs
notes: Scourge-controlled quilboar warren ruled by the lich Amnennar. Classic loot carried over; Lady Falther'ess (Scourge Invasion boss) drops not yet seen in Forever. Forever reworked many Classic items (level/quality/stats), so exact stats may differ.

name: Uldaman
notes: Titan vault in the Badlands. Classic loot carried over; Forever adds new Doomcaller's Pants and Fists of Impending Doom as rewards of the Solution to Doom quest. Forever reworked many Classic items (level/quality/stats), so exact stats may differ.

name: Zul'Farrak
notes: Sandfury troll city in Tanaris with the pyramid event and Gahz'rilla summon. Classic loot carried over; several Classic world drops are listed against ZF bosses but not yet confirmed. Forever reworked many Classic items (level/quality/stats), so exact stats may differ.

name: Maraudon
notes: Centaur burial caverns in Desolace leading to Princess Theradras. Classic loot carried over; Blade of Eternal Darkness not yet seen in Forever. Forever reworked many Classic items (level/quality/stats), so exact stats may differ.

name: Temple of Atal'Hakkar (Sunken Temple)
notes: Sunken troll temple in the Swamp of Sorrows; green dragons guard the top and Eranikus' shade waits below. Classic loot carried over. Forever reworked many Classic items (level/quality/stats), so exact stats may differ.

name: Blackrock Depths
notes: Huge Dark Iron city under Blackrock Mountain; Ring of Law arena bosses rotate. Classic loot carried over; most drops still undiscovered in Forever at time of writing. Part of the Alliance Onyxia attunement. Forever reworked many Classic items (level/quality/stats), so exact stats may differ.

name: Dire Maul: Warpwood Quarter (East)
notes: Corrupted eastern gardens of Eldre'Thalas. Classic loot carried over; Isalien is summoned with the Brazier of Beckoning. Forever reworked many Classic items (level/quality/stats), so exact stats may differ.

name: Dire Maul: Capital Gardens (West)
notes: Highborne wing with pylons guarding Immol'thar. Classic loot carried over; Lord Hel'nurath is a warlock-quest summon and Revanchion a Scourge Invasion boss. Forever reworked many Classic items (level/quality/stats), so exact stats may differ.

name: Dire Maul: Gordok Commons (North)
notes: Gordok ogre wing; a tribute run (leaving guards alive) fills Mizzle's tribute chest. Classic loot carried over. Forever reworked many Classic items (level/quality/stats), so exact stats may differ.

name: Lower Blackrock Spire
notes: Orc-held lower half of the Spire with many rare spawns. Classic loot (incl. Dungeon Set 1 pieces) carried over; part of Horde Onyxia attunement. Forever reworked many Classic items (level/quality/stats), so exact stats may differ.

name: Upper Blackrock Spire
notes: Upper Spire ending at General Drakkisath, where Onyxia attunement concludes. Classic loot (Dungeon Set 1 chests from Drakkisath) carried over; Forever group size not confirmed. Forever reworked many Classic items (level/quality/stats), so exact stats may differ.

name: Scholomance
notes: Necromancy school in Caer Darrow. Classic loot (Dungeon Set 1 helms from Gandling) carried over; Forever trackers have not yet seen most drops. Forever reworked many Classic items (level/quality/stats), so exact stats may differ.

name: Stratholme
notes: Burning city with a Scarlet side (Main Gate) and a Scourge side (Service Gate). Classic loot carried over (Dungeon Set 1 legs from Rivendare); Balnazzar loot may be filed under Grand Crusader Dathrohan. Forever reworked many Classic items (level/quality/stats), so exact stats may differ.

name: Onyxia's Lair
notes: Single-boss 40-player raid in Dustwallow Marsh, unlocking 9 Dec 2026 with the Drakefire Amulet attunement. No Forever loot has been seen yet; the Classic table (Tier 2 helms, Deathbringer, Vis'kag) is listed as an assumption. Forever reworked many Classic items (level/quality/stats), so exact stats may differ.
